label: Pioneered secular political realism and human self-interest, setting the groundwork for Hobbes' Leviathan and state of nature
description: Thomas Hobbes adopted Niccolò Machiavelli's insights and systematically extended them into new metaphysical, ethical, or epistemological domains.
dialecticalTension: Negotiating the intellectual shift from Niccolò Machiavelli's perspective to Thomas Hobbes's reconstructed system.
historicalContext: Direct contemporaneous dialogue and pedagogical transmission during the Early Modern & Scientific era.

label: Bacon praised Machiavelli for describing what men do rather than what they ought to do, establishing empirical political observation
description: Francis Bacon was fundamentally influenced by Niccolò Machiavelli's central inquiries, which shaped the evolution of their philosophical worldview.
dialecticalTension: Negotiating the intellectual shift from Niccolò Machiavelli's perspective to Francis Bacon's reconstructed system.
historicalContext: Direct contemporaneous dialogue and pedagogical transmission during the Early Modern & Scientific era.
